title: Re-entering the Kingswood at its OTHER threshold room (the South Track, on the way out to the Iron Downs) re-fired the same four-companion arrival banter almost verbatim from the original entrance — well after the hold's grief and Wood Question were already fully resolved, so it read as stale/out-of-date flavor text.
where: The South Track (Kingswood, south exit toward Iron Downs)
